subject: literacy
concept: Reading short decodable sentences combining digraphs, blends, and known sight words
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading decodable-text sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds sentences from word tiles using digraph, blend, and sight words already learned
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a decodable sentence to the picture it describes
exercise.abstract: Student reads a short decodable sentence aloud and answers a simple comprehension question about it

misconception_flags: decodes accurately but cannot answer a basic comprehension question about the sentence

interest_binding: sentence content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile, using only decodable vocabulary
